display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac0 读 Verdict
读 task.json meta.verdict.outcome
confirmed / rejected / partial 三分支

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac1 Grill 知识(仅 confirmed)
grilling 追问: 适用范围/限制?
哪些可提炼复用? 流程有何改进?
Q&A 追加 clarifications.jsonl(source:grilling)
→ 产出知识沉淀决策

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac2a 失败处置(仅 rejected)
结论不成立, 不做知识沉淀
从 conclusion.md 失败原因提取教训
写入日志即可
⛔ 跳过 Ac3-Ac5
直接跳到 Ac6 日志

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac2b 部分沉淀+跟进(仅 partial)
⛔ 跳过 Ac1
① 仅沉淀确凿可复用部分
② 创建跟进任务(统一 identity 入口)
task_identity.py create
--slug MMDD-followup-slug
--title '跟进:<未完成部分>' --parent
--scenario-type <继承> --meta.phase plan
③ clarifications.jsonl 记录跟进 ID

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac2 知识沉淀(仅 confirmed)
写入 knowledge//.md
① clarifications.jsonl 追加 knowledge_decision
action: wrote|skipped + reason
② knowledge/manifest.jsonl 追加
version/revision/at/knowledge/knowledge_digest
source_record/source_digest/reason

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac3 记录处置
task.json meta.disposition:
outcome: projected|not_reusable|task_only
reason + at
⛔ 后续 Ac6 journal 前置依赖此项

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac6 追加日志
write-journal Mode A(Task Close)
⛔ 前置: meta.disposition 必须存在
journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md
三段格式: 任务进度/关键决策/阻塞项
追加到末尾不覆盖历史(T0264)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac4 架构改进
结论涉及需改进的架构?
→ 提取改进项
→ 创建新任务或更新 backlog

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac5 跨会话桥接
handoff-work
manual 'handoff' 仅保留为用户入口

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac7 提交(含 disposition)
⛔ 先检查 evidence/manifest.jsonl
不存在→提示先 register-evidence
存在→ git add -A && git commit
-m 'task : 完成并归档'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ac8 归档
① advance-phase 目标 archive
校验 disposition → phase=archive + active=false
② git commit -m 'task : 归档 metadata'
③ mv pdca/tasks/
pdca/tasks/archive/YYYY-MM/

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
